How to start a project

To start a new project choose File > New Project either from the menu or from the toolbar. To add devices to the project, simply click on the device icon in the left part of the window, drag it into the right part of the screen and drop it by releasing the mouse button. Repeat this until you have as many devices as you need in your project.

In an RS-485 network it is necessary that each device on the network has a unique RS-485 address. This is automatically done at the PC by the Race software. Make sure that the physical device addresses for each unit match those in your project.
